programme.desc: Beatrix Potter adaptation with James Corden voicing the mischievous rabbit whose feud with the McGregors reaches new heights.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania
programme.desc: Hotel Transylvania is the perfect place for monsters to escape the human world, until an unwitting hitchhiker tries to check in. Animated fun with the voice of Adam Sandler.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
programme.desc: Dracula recruits his friends to help bring out the monster in his half human, half vampire grandson. Animated sequel with the voices of Adam Sandler and Andy Samberg.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 3: A Monster Vacation
programme.desc: A stressed-out Dracula is whisked away on a luxury summer cruise. Animated fun with the voice of Adam Sandler.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When a stranger claims to be their long lost uncle, the Addams Family attempt to uncover the truth. Comedy with Christina Ricci. With comic violence and flashing images.

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: Sinister sequel fun as Uncle Fester falls for the fiendish family's suspicious new babysitter. Comedy with Anjelica Huston, with comic violence and flashing images.

programme.title: Yogi Bear
programme.desc: Yogi and Boo-Boo must save Jellystone Park in this live action version of the classic cartoon. Dan Aykroyd and Justin Timberlake voice the misbehaving bears.(78mins).

programme.title: Monster House
programme.desc: Three kids unearth the alarming truth beyond the doorstep of a creepy old house. Spooky family animation with the voices of Steve Buscemi and Kevin James. Flashing images.

programme.title: Karate Kid: Legends
programme.desc: Li Fong relocates to New York City and attracts unwanted attention from a local karate champion. He embarks on a journey to enter the ultimate karate competition.

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: A man and his dog are fused together to turn into Dog Man. They must stop a cat from cloning himself and creating an evil kitten.

programme.title: The Spongebob Squarepants Movie
programme.desc: When Neptune's crown is stolen, SpongeBob and Patrick set out to clear Mr Krabs' name. Absorbingly offbeat cartoon caper with a cameo from David Hasselhoff. Flashing images.(84mins).

programme.title: The Spongebob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
programme.desc: SpongeBob and the gang leap into action when a pirate steals the secret recipe for Krabby Patties. Family adventure. Flashing images.

programme.title: The Boss Baby
programme.desc: Animated comedy about a youngster concerned that his baby brother is actually a power-hungry tycoon sent to destroy his perfect family life.

programme.title: The Rugrats Movie
programme.desc: Tommy and co try to return his new baby brother to the hospital in this fun animation. With the voices of Whoopi Goldberg and Busta Rhymes. Contains flashing images.

programme.title: Rugrats Go Wild
programme.desc: It's cartoon chaos when the little terrors are marooned on an island with the nature-nutty Thornberrys. Messy fun with the voice of Bruce Willis.

programme.title: Madagascar
programme.desc: Alex the lion, Marty the zebra and hypochondriac giraffe Melman swap Manhattan zoo for madcap Madagascar. Fun-filled cartoon antics from the makers of Shrek.

programme.title: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa
programme.desc: Further fish-out-of-water antics as the zoo-reared pals crash-land on the mother continent. Family animation with Ben Stiller.

programme.title: Cats & Dogs
programme.desc: Fur flies as the kung fu cats of power-hungry Mr Tinkles battle for world domination against a pack of canine commandos. Animal antics. Mild violence/flashing images.

programme.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge Of Kitty Galore
programme.desc: With a feline superspy plotting world domination, cats and dogs must put their rivalries aside to defeat her. Family fun. Mild violence/flashing images.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning
programme.desc: IMF agent Ethan Hunt is in exile with both halves of the 3D cruciform key that can unlock the source code of rogue AI creation, the Entity. Hunt returns to London to reunite with Luther Stickell, Benji Dunn and former thief Grace. The Entity's human henchman, Gabriel, is still on the loose, so Hunt bolsters his ranks with vengeful French assassin Paris and US intelligence agent Theo Degas. Action thriller, starring Tom Cruise, Hayley Atwell, Ving Rhames, Simon Pegg and Esai Morales.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible
programme.desc: Secret agents suspect there is a traitor in their organisation when their latest assignment ends in disaster. The sole survivor is accused of being the mole, forcing him to go on the run to clear his name. However, in the process, he discovers a former Russian spy is selling information about the world's leading undercover operatives. Action thriller based on the 1960s TV series, starring Tom Cruise, Jon Voight and Ving Rhames.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible 2
programme.desc: Secret agent Ethan Hunt is sent to find and destroy the only sample of a deadly man-made virus. However, he faces tough opposition in a former spy-turned-criminal mastermind who has already acquired the cure and now wants the pathogen itself. Director John Woo's action thriller sequel, starring Tom Cruise, Dougray Scott, Thandiwe Newton and Anthony Hopkins.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible III
programme.desc: Former secret agent Ethan Hunt is called out of retirement when an ex-trainee is taken hostage by a ruthless arms dealer, but when the rescue operation goes wrong, the villain decides to target Hunt's fiancee. Action thriller sequel directed by JJ Abrams, starring Tom Cruise, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Michelle Monaghan, Ving Rhames and Simon Pegg.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Ghost Protocol
programme.desc: Secret agent Ethan Hunt and his team are implicated in a bombing at the Kremlin, forcing the American president to declare them fugitives. The spies plan to clear their name by abducting the real terrorist, which leads them into a pursuit around the globe. However, Hunt cannot be sure his colleagues are trustworthy. Action adventure sequel, starring Tom Cruise, Jeremy Renner, Simon Pegg and Paula Patton.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation
programme.desc: The team of secret agents faces being shut down when the head of the CIA convinces the US Senate that it is too dangerous. The operatives of the Impossible Mission Force become fugitives when they defy orders and plot to bring down a shadowy society of assassins. Spy thriller sequel, starring Tom Cruise, Jeremy Renner, Rebecca Ferguson and Simon Pegg.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Fallout
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt and the IMF team join forces with CIA assassin August Walker to prevent a disaster caused by mysterious arms dealer John Lark and a group of terrorists known as the Apostles. However, Hunt and his colleagues are soon pushed to their limits thanks to a face from their past. Writer/director Christopher McQuarrie's sixth entry in the action thriller saga, starring Tom Cruise, Henry Cavill, Ving Rhames, Simon Pegg and Rebecca Ferguson.

programme.title: xXx
programme.desc: Extreme sports star Xander Cage finds himself in trouble when his daredevil exploits land him behind bars. Action adventure, starring Vin Diesel, Samuel L Jackson, Asia Argento, Marton Csokas and Michael Roof.

programme.title: xXx: The Next Level
programme.desc: The American secretary of defence forms a covert military organisation with the intention of assassinating the president. Action sequel, starring Ice Cube, Samuel L Jackson and Willem Dafoe.

programme.title: Woman on the Run
programme.desc: After witnessing a murder, Frank Johnson goes on the run to avoid being killed himself. His wife, Eleanor (Ann Sheridan), seems almost apathetic about finding him when questioned by Investigator Harris (Robert Keith), due to a marriage on the rocks. However, after learning that Frank has a grave heart condition, Eleanor recruits reporter Dan Leggett (Dennis O'Keefe) to help track down Frank. Discovering new love for her husband along the way, Eleanor must get to Frank before the killer does.

programme.desc: San Francisco businessman Harry Graham (Edmond O'Brien) and his wife and business partner, Eve (Joan Fontaine), are in the process of adopting a child. In flashback, Graham tells of the strains in his marriage with Eve and how he found himself falling for the kind-hearted waitress Phyllis while on a business trip.

Needing all the help he can get, Brant agrees, but running with these bandits only gets him deeper into trouble -- while the real killer remains on the loose.

Thompson is questioned by Deputy Walter Gordon (Kermit Maynard) when Gordon's brother, the sheriff, goes missing. While investigating this disappearance, Thompson is given a cryptic clue by rancher Joe Moore (Al Ferguson), but Moore is killed before he can elaborate. Thompson and Gordon must then join forces to find the truth.

Believing something's off, Yankee has an elderly associate, Shaggy (Clem Bevans), pose as a rich man and offer a reward for clues about the killing.

programme.title: Stars Over Texas
programme.desc: Cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) have come to the end of a tough cattle drive, but, instead of the rancher they were expecting, they're welcomed by his sister, young Terry Lawrence (Shirley Patterson). It seems that Terry's brother and one of his employees were wounded by gun-toting thugs. Eddie and Soapy realize that they'll need to get to the bottom of things, so they devise a clever plan to lure the bad guys back to the scene.

programme.title: Thunder Town
programme.desc: Falsely accused of bank robbery, Jim Brandon (Bob Steele) is released from jail after his supposed criminal partner commits suicide. Back home, he finds that, aside from his stalwart friends, Betty Morgan (Ellen Hall) and Utah McGirk (Syd Saylor), most people in his small town still believe he's guilty. Drawn into a land dispute with Dunc Rankin (Edward Howard) over his own and Betty's ranches, Jim also discovers that his dead friend may have been murdered.

programme.title: Border Feud
programme.desc: A feud has broken out over control of a Nevada gold mine, and Sheriff Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) realizes that he needs a steady hand by his side. Good thing Fuzzy is pals with Cheyenne Davis (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), an out-of-towner who specializes in fighting crime. Beckoned by Fuzzy, Cheyenne arrives just as local beauty Carol Condon (Gloria Marlen) is taken captive by one of the warring parties. Cheyenne and Fuzzy will have to act fast in order to free her and defuse the tension.

programme.title: The Westward Trail
programme.desc: City slicker Ann (Phyllis Planchard) and her little brother Tom (Steve Drake) leave Chicago and buy a ranch out West, and Ann struggles to run things. She meets Larson (Bob Duncan), a crooked local saloon keeper who woos her, but he also wants her land so he can get to the silver that's located on it. As part of his effort to grab all the land he can, Larson kills the town sheriff and assumes his position, alarming good-guy cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), who swoops in and tries to rescue Ann.

programme.title: Paradise Canyon
programme.desc: Rough-and-tumble federal agent John Wyatt (John Wayne) receives an unusual undercover assignment: He must infiltrate the ranks of an Arizona-based medicine show. Wyatt's boss suspects the show's shifty-eyed proprietor, ex-convict Dr. Carter (Earle Hodgins), of running a massive counterfeiting operation. With the full cooperation of the local authorities, Wyatt poses as a sharpshooter and begins his investigation -- only to fall for Carter's beautiful daughter, Linda (Marion Burns).

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: Black Hills
programme.desc: When their father is shot by Dan Kirby (Terry Frost) after discovering a gold mine on his ranch, Larry Hadley (Steve Drake) and his sister, Janet (Shirley Patterson), ask foreman Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) for help in retaining their land. Eddie's arrival with sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) disrupts Dan's plans to take over the property. Desperate to obtain the ranch, Dan blackmails accountant Tuttle (Bill Fawcett) into forging a document that will help him take control.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: Little Big Horn
programme.desc: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).

programme.title: Incident at Oglala
programme.desc: Robert Redford narrates this documentary about the Pine Ridge Shootout on an Oglala Sioux reservation in South Dakota. On June 26, 1975, two FBI agents are searching for tribesman Leonard Peltier, wanted in connection with an assault. They are killed after coming under heavy fire, presumably from Peltier and his accomplices. However, proponents claim that the FBI botched the investigation by tampering with and suppressing evidence, and that Peltier's imprisonment is a miscarriage of justice.

Meanwhile, Homer and Tommy wander through the nighttime city, looking for fights, playing poker and discussing their problems as Native Americans.
